items.q: Does BBA (Hons.) with a Majors & Minors at ATLAS ISME offer a globally benchmarked curriculum?
a: Yes, BBA (Hons.) with a Major & Minor at ATLAS ISME offers a globally benchmarked curriculum.

The 4-year BBA curriculum has been created to ensure a transformative leadership experience for students. It has been carefully curated to ensure integration of current industry best practices and future needs of Industry 4.0.

In fact, distinguished CEO's and corporate leaders from Tata Sons Ltd., AMAZON, NYKAA, Lenskart, Hindustan Unilever Limited, Nestle, HDFC Bank and also from some of the best international universities visit the school as speakers and visiting lecturers.

items.q: What kind of real-industry brand collaborations or marketing simulations are built into the learning experience at ATLAS ISME?
a: With hands-on industry experience and in-depth knowledge of different marketing channels and platforms, students are equipped with the dynamics of marketing. Students participate in live projects across sectors such as FMCG, retail and technology and we help individuals refine their skills and prepare them for real-world challenges and market stimuli.

items.q: Does ATLAS ISME provide CAT and CFA exam coaching on campus?
a: Yes, ATLAS ISME provides students with CAT and CFA exam coaching on campus. The modules of our course are designed so that students are coached for the CAT & CFA exams. With case studies and industry notes, we ensure students have in-depth knowledge and are well-prepared for the exam.

items.q: How to get admission to the ATLAS ISME BBA program?
a: The admission process at ATLAS ISME consists of 3 key stages:

items: Online test assessing aptitude and reasoning
Evaluation of communication, intent and profile
Group activity based on a real-world business case

items.q: Can I choose electives across business, design and tech at ATLAS ISME?
a: Yes, ATLAS ISME offers multidisciplinary learning. At ATLAS ISME, we always ensure flexibility and our main focus is for students to explore diverse interests and broaden their horizons by taking carefully curated electives in areas like fashion design, AI & machine learning and VFX, even alongside a business degree. This flexibility is key to developing well-rounded, future-ready professionals.

items.q: Can ATLAS undergraduate students launch real startups while earning credits and how do these ventures receive support?

items.q: Can students align their coursework with professional certifications?
a: Yes, students can align their coursework with professional certifications. The institution offers certifications such as FinTech & AI Investing (LIBF), which prepares students for digital finance; Portfolio & Wealth Management (NISM), which builds expertise in managing investments and financial portfolios; and Mutual Fund & Financial Services (NISM), which provides a foundation in financial advisory and investment strategy.
These certifications help students build confidence, gain deeper knowledge and understanding and improve their readiness for job opportunities.
